mapper.select: INSERT INTO source_route (source_id, layer, config, status, origin, verified_at, last_ok, last_error, onboarded_at, backfilled_at) VALUES (#{o.sourceId}, #{o.layer}, #{o.config, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{o.status}, #{o.origin}, #{o.verifiedAt}, #{o.lastOk}, #{o.lastError}, #{o.onboardedAt}, #{o.backfilledAt}) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO source_route (source_id, layer, config, status, origin, verified_at, last_ok, last_error, onboarded_at, backfilled_at) VALUES (#{o.sourceId}, #{o.layer}, #{o.config, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{o.status}, #{o.origin}, #{o.verifiedAt}, #{o.lastOk}, #{o.lastError}, #{o.onboardedAt}, #{o.backfilledAt}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, layer, config) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT * FROM source_route WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY id

SELECT r.* FROM source_route r JOIN source s ON s.id = r.source_id WHERE r.status = 'VERIFIED' AND s.active AND s.tier IN ('CORE','BROAD') AND s.publication_status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.type = 'HARVEST_' || r.layer AND t.state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND t.payload->>'routeId' = r.id::text) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.type = 'HARVEST_' || r.layer AND t.state = 'DEAD' AND t.payload->>'routeId' = r.id::text AND t.payload->>'mode' = 'ONBOARDING' AND (r.verified_at IS NULL OR t.finished > r.verified_at)) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE source_route SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_route SET last_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_route SET verified_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_route SET last_ok = #{at}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_route SET onboarded_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE source_route SET backfilled_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: UPDATE source_route SET long_restarts = long_restarts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} RETURNING long_restarts
mapper.update: UPDATE source_route SET long_restarts = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND long_restarts <> 0
mapper.select: SELECT layer, status, count(*)::bigint AS n FROM source_route GROUP BY layer, status
mapper.update: UPDATE source_route SET status = 'PAUSED', last_error = #{reason} WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','VERIFIED','PENDING')
